messages:
ana (PM): Quick sync — we need to land a pragmatic console observability scope for Q2. Customers asking for dashboards + cost breakdown + error slicing. Can we agree on launch checkpoints?

matt (eng): TL;DR: core telemetry + traces + route-level cost is doable if we cut advanced trace sampling and anomaly detection for later.

sara (eng-sre): Agree. Must-have for launch: request-level tracing hooks, per-model latency histograms, and error rate by route. Without those on day 1, SLOs are impossible.

june (UX): For dashboards, we should ship 3 prebuilt views: overview (latency/cost/errors), per-route drilldown, and incident triage. Keep them configurable but not fully customizable at GA.

omar (data): Cost breakdown: we can show token cost + infra estimate per request. Per-customer cost attribution needs join keys from requests; depends on header availability from the API. Needs a small schema change.

kevin (CS): Customers repeatedly asked for per-tenant cost and alerting. If we delay per-tenant attribution, we must be explicit in the roadmap and provide a workaround (csv export or billing API).

ana (PM): @kevin noted. Proposal: GA must include: dashboards (3 views), trace hooks (server-side spans + trace ids in logs), and route-level cost estimates. Per-tenant billing and anomaly detection = GA+1. Thoughts?

matt (eng): Implementation notes: trace hooks = light instrumentation + span headers. We'll add a sampling flag defaulting to 1% for high-volume routes to protect runtime. We can keep full trace on-demand for canary customers.

sara (eng-sre): Important: sampling needs to be configurable per-route via the Console. Also retention defaults: 7d for traces, 30d for metrics. Longer retention is a paid add-on.

june (UX): UX risk: showing sampled traces with no obvious sampling indicator will confuse users. Add a small badge on timelines: "sampled 1%" and a tooltip explaining implications.

omar (data): For cost math: token_cost + infra_estimate (gpu-minutes * hw_rate). We can surface a confidence band. Will need a nightly job to compute per-route aggregates.

kevin (CS): Also flag: enterprise procurement teams want exportable audit logs of rollout events and who pinned model versions. Is that in scope for GA? Customers are asking.

ana (PM): Noted — audit logs are adjacent but high priority. Suggest GA: include basic event stream with export; advanced audit analytics = GA+1.

matt (eng): Engineering ask: we need a gated rollout plan. Start with internal + 3 pilot customers on Dedicated/Dedicated-like traffic. Then open to wider GA. That reduces blowups.

sara (eng-sre): And a fallback policy: if cost calc pipeline fails, Console should show "estimated" with a link to raw request logs. No phantom zeros.

june (UX): Launch criteria checklist suggestion:
- 3 dashboards implemented and wired
- trace header present and sample controls exposed
- route-level cost shown with confidence band
- SLO dashboard with error budgets
- CSV export for billing data
- Pilot with 3 customers & runbook validated

ana (PM): I'll turn that into a formal acceptance checklist. Quick prioritization decision: drop anomaly detection and per-tenant billing from GA. Keep audit export minimal. We can still demo per-tenant plan to sales.

kevin (CS): Works for me so long as we promise a clear roadmap and a timeline for per-tenant billing. Sales needs a one-pager.

omar (data): Timeline estimate: core pipelines + dashboards = 6 weeks with two engineers and one data engineer. Per-tenant billing add-on = additional 3 weeks.

matt (eng): Ok. I'll scope tickets: two infra tickets (trace headers + retention), one batch job for cost aggregation, and three dashboard tasks. Will post a short RAID (risks, assumptions, issues, decisions).

sara (eng-sre): Risk callouts: high-cardinality route tags can bloat storage. We need tag normalization rules. Also potential perf impact if tracing is too chatty.

june (UX): Small ask: include a "What changed" modal on first-run pointing to docs and limitations (sampling, retention). Reduces support overhead.

ana (PM): Great. Action items: matt = tickets + RAID by EOD Wed; omar = cost math spec + sample job sketch by Thu; june = dashboard mocks by Fri; kevin = one-pager for sales by next Tue; sara = runbook draft for pilot by next Tue.

infra-bot: Deployment window scheduled for pilot infra on 1979002200 UTC.

kevin (CS): Thanks all. I'll line up pilot customers once mockups land. :thumbsup:

ana (PM): Closing note — we'll re-evaluate anomaly detection and per-tenant billing at the mid-quarter review. If anyone needs to reprioritize, ping me in thread.
